# routeros_system_clock_manual (Resource)


## Example Usage
```terraform
resource "routeros_system_clock_manual" "manual" {
  dst_delta = "192.0.2.1"
  dst_end   = "192.0.2.1"
  dst_start = "192.0.2.1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `___id___` (Number) <em>Resource ID type (.id / name). This is an internal service field, setting a value is not required.</em>
- `___path___` (String) <em>Resource path for CRUD operations. This is an internal service field, setting a value is not required.</em>
- `dst_delta` (String) The time offset that is added to the GMT offset while the daylight saving time is active, written as `+HH:MM` or `-HH:MM`.
- `dst_end` (String) Date and time when the daylight saving time ends, written as `YYYY-MM-DD hh:mm:ss` (for example `1970-01-01 00:00:00`).
- `dst_start` (String) Date and time when the daylight saving time starts, written as `YYYY-MM-DD hh:mm:ss` (for example `1970-01-01 00:00:00`).
- `time_zone` (String) The GMT offset that is used when the time zone is configured manually, written as `+HH:MM` or `-HH:MM`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Import
Import is supported using the following syntax:
```shell
#The ID can be found via API or the terminal
#The command for the terminal is -> :put [/system/clock/manual get [print show-ids]]
terraform import routeros_system_clock_manual.manual "*1"
```
